title: Mixed Event — Happy Lovely Everyday! — Episode6 As An Idol

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! are delighted to receive a request to perform at an elementary school. With experience performing in children's variety shows under her belt, Airi enthusiastically starts planning for the event.

rows.Line: Stage SEKAI

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Okay, when you put it all together, it goes something like this...!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: So we do some quick self-intros, talk about what we do each day, what goes on behind the scenes during our shows and maybe throw in some fun games to play with everyone...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: And we cap it all off by thanking them all for coming to see us! Yeah, this should work great!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Oh, I like the third part the most!
I really don't know what'll happen, but it'd be so much fun to do a tongue-twister battle with Len!

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
How do you do it, Airi?
Where do you get all these great ideas?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, I've been doing this for a while now...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Is something wrong...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Uh, no... It's nothing.
I was reminded of something, is all.

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
Is it something bad...?
Wanna try talking about it?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Yeah, you helped us so much already. If there's something bothering you, we want to help.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Thanks, you guys...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Well, if you don't mind, we can talk about it a little.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Which is why I haven't been feeling all that great lately...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I had no idea...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I know that dwelling on the past like this is pointless, but my mind just always seems to wander back to that time.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Do you not like how your past self agreed to appear on all those variety shows...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
No, I don't hate myself or anything...
I just feel a little lost, you know...?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: There was a time when I really loved seeing how an idol shined on stage, and I decided that I wanted to be just like them.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: As I started learning more and more about idols, I convinced myself that making others feel the way I did was the best way to go.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Eventually, that turned into “inspiring hope” in others.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But while I was on those variety shows, it felt like I completely lost touch with that...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line:
How?
Variety idols are still idols, right?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I know.
I know, but...

rows.Speaker: Fan A
rows.Line: Every time I see you perform, Yu Yu, I'm filled with so much hope! It's like I know tomorrow's going to be a wonderful day! Thank you for everything!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (The odds of someone telling me that back then were...)

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Airi...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I don't think you lost touch...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I think Airi the Variety Idol never lost touch and spread hope to people like she said she would.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I mean that you gave us hope when you were giving us advice on how to MC.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: It became so clear that you put a lot of effort into making sure your fans genuinely enjoy themselves. Am I wrong?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: I'm certain that you maintained that work ethic and passion while you were on those variety shows.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: You did everything you could “for your fans”, right? I'm sure you were able to touch the hearts of so many people because of that.

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: They had to believe that tomorrow would be amazing because of you, Airi.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Really? You think so...?

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Of course. Maybe not everyone feels the same way about this...

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: But I'm positive that there are people out there who you were able to reach and inspire.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Len...

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: Len, that was perfect!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Huh?

rows.Speaker: Rin
rows.Line: I wanted to say what you just said, but wasn't really sure how to say it so... Thanks for saying it so perfectly!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Hehe. You're welcome, Rin...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Yeah, I need to thank you too.
I feel much better now, Len.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I'm gonna give our next event everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Len
rows.Line: Great! I know you will, Airi!
A few days later
Miyamasuzaka Girls Academy - Rooftop

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Okay, shall we begin our sneak peek stream?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But before we start, I need to ask you something, Airi...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Huh? What's up?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you want people to see you as you are right now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Do you want everyone to see Airi Momoi of MORE MORE JUMP! who puts everything she can into her singing, dancing and MCing?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Huh...?
What do you mean...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Please.
Just try to answer honestly.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Of course I do!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Idols can't inspire hope in anyone if nobody's there to see them!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Understood. Thank you...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Then let's begin our stream.
Minori, can you get us started?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yup!
Pressing start... Now.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Thank you for watching our stream!
We actually have a bit of a special announcement to make.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Hm? You do?>
<Special announcement!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
Can you guess what it is?
Hehe. Would you three like to give the answer?

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah! Of course!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
We're gonna...!
Do a special graduation event at an elementary school!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Unfortunately, it's about to be closed down. We received a request to perform for the students and make it a special occasion for them.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You're doing a show at an elementary school?!>
<That's so sad, but I'm super jealous too!>
<Come to our school too! Please!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We won't just be doing a show either. We're gonna play all sorts of fun games with the kids too.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We'll be breaking into teams, competing against each other and streaming all of it! This isn't something we usually do, so I hope you'll remember to tune in!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<I totally will!>
<This is gonna be awesome! I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: You'll also get to see a separate special performance...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Uh, Haruka?
What special performance...?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: The four of us will be doing a show, but you'll also get to see Airi do a special solo performance.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: After the school contacted us about this event, we received some messages from the students... And Airi received the most messages.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Which is why we think that they'll really like to see Airi do a solo show.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Yeah, I wanna see it too!>
<I love how her singing voice is so uplifting!>

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Is this why you asked me that question just now...?)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Alright, if they want to see me sing that much, I can't really say no, huh?

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: So make sure to check it out, you guys! I'm gonna give my solo show everything I have!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Our next stream is going to be very special, so we hope that you'll be there to join us! Stay tuned, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Uh, Haruka...
I'm doing a whole show on my own now?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Yes, and the reason is simple. Like I said, you received the most number of messages from the students.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But that doesn't mean they all like...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: If these students were only interested in Happy Everyday, then the school would've only asked you to come.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: But they asked for MORE MORE JUMP! That makes me think these kids want to see Airi Momoi and not Happy Everyday.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Did you ask her to do this, Shizuku...?

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: No. Haruka was actually the first to realize that something was bothering you.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: A-Also...!!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I really want those who've only seen you on variety shows to see the real you, Airi! I want them to see Airi Momoi the idol!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I... I think it's such a shame that some people have this incomplete image of you in their heads...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I'm of the same opinion.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: I really hope these students get a chance to see the girl behind The Masked Variety Idol, Happy Everyday they love so much.

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Mask or no mask, you have a talent for inspiring hope in others. You're an inspiration to them...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: *Sigh*...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: I mean, talk about a curveball. Who makes someone do a show like this?

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I'm sorry.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: But I already agreed to do it, so I have no choice but to follow through.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Airi...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We're gonna give it everything we got starting today all the way through the event!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Oh, Airi, I'd like to make a small request too...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Since you'll be performing on your own, what if you sang that one song...?
